Definition: from G1722 and G2919; to judge in, i.e. count among:--make of the number.
BiblicalUsage: Paul says he dares not make himself of the number of those who commend themselves in 2 Corinthians 10:12 — men measuring themselves by themselves and comparing themselves among themselves, which is not wise.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe self-measurement is a fool's game, and the only comparison that matters is Christ's measure, not my neighbour's.
